title: Oikonomou2016 – SSVEP MAMEM 3 dataset
description: A steady-state visual evoked potential (SSVEP) EEG dataset from 11 healthy, BCI-naive subjects who focused on boxes flickering at five frequencies (6.66, 7.50, 8.57, 10.00 and 12.00 Hz). Signals were recorded with 14 channels at 128 Hz and preprocessed with bandpass and notch filtering, artifact removal and common average referencing. The dataset supports comparative evaluation of filtering, artifact removal, feature extraction and classification algorithms for SSVEP-based brain-computer interfaces.
methods_description: Subjects viewed flickering boxes on a 22-inch LCD monitor, with a yellow arrow marking the target box. Each 5 s flicker window was followed by 5 s of rest, with a single adaptation period before the first of 5 sessions. EEG was recorded at 128 Hz and preprocessed with 5-48 Hz bandpass filtering, 50 Hz notch filtering, AMUSE/ICA artifact removal and common average referencing.
